en: A black‑and‑white street-view postcard showing a broad avenue lined with two‑ and three‑story historic buildings in European architectural style. Leafless trees stand along the sidewalks, and many people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or gather on both sides of the street. Horse-drawn carriages are visible on the road. On one prominent building a sign reads 'Hotel Central'. At the bottom of the image there is a caption in Serbo-Croatian Latin script indicating the location as King Peter Street in Zemun.
